images.name: 3B
images.prompt: Vertical epic cinematic film still, photorealistic, anamorphic lens, city street at dusk in light rain, wet reflective pavement, warm glowing shop windows, teal-and-amber color grade, fine film grain, shallow depth of field. The upper third is dark night sky or a dark awning, empty. No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks. Subject: a man seen from behind standing still under a shop awning, his arm relaxed at his side holding one phone loosely, head slightly lifted, rain falling beyond the awning, calm mood.
